scenes.narration: This robot passed its open-arena test. Watch what happens when a pedestrian crosses.
scenes.title: A test is not a guarantee

scenes.narration: I built EmbodiWeave to answer two questions: which robot checkpoint should I retrain, and is the result safe to ship?
scenes.title: Which checkpoint? Safe to ship?

scenes.narration: Falkor-D-B connects policies, training runs, trials, evaluations, failures and decisions. The links preserve what produced what.
scenes.title: The history is a graph

scenes.narration: First, the agent queries failed validation suites, matching the exact artifact hash. A look-alike checkpoint cannot substitute for measured evidence.
scenes.title: Diagnose the exact artifact

scenes.narration: Matching tensor shapes are not enough. Falkor-D-B links sensor and action contracts, so incompatible starting points are excluded.
scenes.title: Same shape. Different meaning.

scenes.narration: The planner ranks eligible origins by failed suites and deficits. Before training, its decision records the Cypher, parameters and returned evidence in Falkor-D-B.
scenes.title: The decision is evidence too

scenes.narration: If Falkor-D-B is unavailable, planning stops. There is no silent fallback.
scenes.title: No graph. No plan.

scenes.narration: Longer training came first. A retained-task failure then led to rehearsal across training families. Each attempt added about three hundred thousand P-P-O steps.
scenes.title: Two measured training attempts

scenes.narration: Falkor-D-B chose the rehearsal checkpoint for six hundred thousand more P-P-O steps, with double the collision penalty. The saved candidate passed all four unchanged validation suites.
scenes.title: The graph chose a stronger collision cost.

scenes.narration: I froze its hash before a fresh confirmation batch. All four suites passed. Target collisions: eight in one hundred. The limit stayed ten percent. The earlier failure remains visible.
scenes.title: Frozen first. Confirmed once.

scenes.narration: Physics still exposed a gap. The same checkpoint, without retraining in MuJoCo, collided six times in forty target episodes, and four times in crossing. This is no physical safety certificate.
scenes.title: New physics still exposed a gap.

scenes.narration: The graph and checksummed evidence make these results inspectable. EmbodiWeave. Built on Falkor-D-B.
scenes.title: Robot training decisions you can audit.
